routes.workbook_dates_interpretation: Old workbook creation/printing dates are template metadata, not reference years; table headers2024/25 and status30March2026 retained separately.

numeric_scope_checks.difference_explanation: Observed published-cell arithmetic; no hidden unrounded values reconstructed or specific rounding method certified.

routes.completeness_and_actuality: T10 labels published SSP teacher VZÄ by employment contract, not planned posts or school leaders. T1/T8/T10 supply no explicit missing-report, imputation or completeness certification in their footnotes. No missing symbol found in these sheets does not establish all actual target activity is covered, nor a one-sided error guarantee. Original underlying personnel records were not obtained.
routes.bound_status: Potential covering-denominator ingredient only; no city envelope asserted or admitted in this bounded check.
remaining_conditions: Prove that the relevant actual city upper-secondary teaching activities are all contained in the published public/private teacher populations, including unspecified-stage activities and any programme exclusions.
Match the exact upper-stage student population and reference year/date; no new matched city student numerator was collected here.
Check publication completeness, any estimation/allocation conventions, and source precision before calling a total a guaranteed upper bound.
Private general-upper F11 alone is not a proved city private-upper cover: other private stages/mixed or unallocated activities cannot simply be omitted.
routes.decision: New quantitative private+public FTE lead retained for independent coverage review; do not construct a city PTR or utility from it without those checks.

statement_limit: These three routes do not establish that no suitable source exists elsewhere. No old source, model result, user CSV, registry or manuscript was edited.
